name: MSc Computer Science
overview: A thesis-based research master's. Course-based professional master's at Toronto cost substantially more - check which type a programme is before comparing prices.

name: MEng Electrical and Computer Engineering
overview: A course-based professional master's completed in as little as three terms. The fee is for the full programme rather than per year.

name: MSc Computer Science
overview: Research master's tuition at UBC is charged as a flat annual programme fee and is among the lowest at any top-50 university in North America.

name: MASc Civil Engineering
overview: A thesis-based engineering master's, normally taken with a supervisor secured before application and often accompanied by a research stipend.

name: MSc Electrical Engineering
overview: English-medium study in Montreal, where rent is well below Toronto and Vancouver. Quebec sets its own international fee schedule.

name: MMath Data Science
overview: Waterloo's co-operative education model alternates study with paid work terms, which can offset a meaningful share of the fee.

name: MSc Petroleum Engineering
overview: Lower tuition and living costs than the larger Canadian cities, with strong links to the energy sector in Alberta.

name: Master of Information Technology
overview: Charged per year across a two-year degree, so budget roughly double the figure shown for the full programme plus Melbourne living costs.

name: Master of Engineering (Civil)
overview: A three-year accredited engineering master's for applicants without a cognate bachelor's; shorter tracks exist for those who hold one.

name: Master of Information Technology
overview: UNSW runs three terms a year, which allows a two-year master's to be compressed into roughly twenty months.

name: Master of Data Science
overview: Also deliverable in part at Monash Malaysia at considerably lower cost, with transfer to Melbourne for the remainder.

name: Master of Engineering Science
overview: Brisbane living costs run below Sydney and Melbourne while tuition is comparable.

name: Master of Commerce
overview: A broad business master's in Australia's most expensive city; factor accommodation into any comparison with Brisbane or Adelaide.

name: MS Computer Science and Engineering
overview: Tuition at Korea's flagship national university is modest by OECD standards, and many international graduate students hold a Korean Government Scholarship or departmental waiver that reduces it further.

name: MA International Studies
overview: Taught in English at the Graduate School of International Studies, with a regional focus on East Asia.

name: MS Electrical Engineering
overview: Admitted graduate students at KAIST normally receive a full tuition waiver plus a monthly stipend, so the effective tuition is zero. The award is competitive and is confirmed in the admission letter rather than guaranteed.

name: MS Artificial Intelligence
overview: A dedicated AI graduate school. As with other KAIST graduate programmes, admission normally carries a full tuition waiver and stipend.

name: MBA Global
overview: A private-university MBA taught entirely in English in Seoul, with a large international cohort.

name: MS Mechanical Engineering
overview: Research-led engineering with industry links to Korea's manufacturing sector.

name: MS Materials Science and Engineering
overview: A small, research-intensive institute where graduate admission normally includes full funding. Places are few and selection is based mainly on research fit.

name: Master of Computer Science
overview: Malaysia's highest-ranked university. The figure is the full-programme international fee, not an annual rate, and living costs in Kuala Lumpur are a fraction of Western destinations.

name: Master of Public Health
overview: A taught public-health master's with substantial fieldwork, well suited to applicants from South Asian health systems.

name: Master of Agricultural Science
overview: UPM's core strength. Directly relevant to Bangladeshi agriculture, aquaculture and food-security work, at a low total cost.

name: Master of Engineering (Civil)
overview: An engineering-focused public university in Johor Bahru, across the strait from Singapore, with a large South Asian student community.

name: Master of Business Administration
overview: Awards the same Monash degree as Melbourne at a far lower cost, with the option of completing part of the programme in Australia.

name: MSc Computer Science
overview: A one-year taught master's, which keeps the total cost below two-year systems even where the annual fee looks similar. Dublin accommodation is scarce - apply early.

name: MSc Data and Computational Science
overview: One year taught, with a substantial research project. Ireland's one-year master's structure also shortens the time to a post-study work permit.

name: MSc Software Design and Development
overview: A conversion-friendly one-year master's with noticeably lower tuition and living costs than Dublin.

name: MSc Food Science
overview: Cork hosts a dense cluster of food and pharmaceutical employers, which supports placement and graduate recruitment.

name: MSc Computing (Artificial Intelligence)
overview: An industry-oriented one-year master's with established work-placement routes, at the lower end of Dublin tuition.

name: MSc Informatics
overview: Taught in English at one of Europe's strongest computer science faculties. Non-EU students pay TUM's reintroduced tuition of 4,000-6,000 EUR per semester depending on the programme tier, plus the Munich semester fee of roughly 85 EUR.

name: MSc Mechanical Engineering
overview: A research-led master's with strong automotive and aerospace industry links. Non-EU tuition applies at 4,000-6,000 EUR per semester; verify the tier for this programme.

name: MSc Management and Technology
overview: TUM School of Management's flagship English-taught degree combining business with an engineering or natural-science specialisation. Charged at the upper 6,000 EUR per semester tier for non-EU students.

name: MSc Computer Science
overview: No tuition is charged to non-EU students in North Rhine-Westphalia. The annual cost shown is the semester contribution for two semesters, which includes a transport pass valid across the Aachen region and into Belgium and the Netherlands.

name: MSc Automotive Engineering
overview: An English-taught specialisation drawing on RWTH's automotive research institutes. No tuition for non-EU students; the figure shown is the annual semester contribution.

name: MSc Data Science
overview: Statistics, machine learning and large-scale data engineering. No tuition for non-EU students; the figure shown is the annual semester contribution.

name: MSc Computer Science
overview: Berlin charges no tuition to non-EU students. The annual figure is the semester contribution for two semesters and includes the VBB transport pass for Berlin and Brandenburg.

name: MSc Energy Engineering
overview: Covers renewable generation, grid integration and energy economics. No tuition for non-EU students; the figure shown is the annual semester contribution.

name: MSc Data Science
overview: LMU had not introduced non-EU tuition when this was recorded, so the cost is the Munich semester contribution only. Confirm on the programme page before advising, as Bavarian policy is changing institution by institution.

name: MSc Epidemiology
overview: A quantitative public-health master's taught in English at LMU's medical faculty. Semester contribution only at the time of recording.

name: MSc Molecular Biosciences
overview: Taught in English alongside the EMBL and the German Cancer Research Center. Baden-Wurttemberg charges non-EU students 1,500 EUR per semester, giving the 3,000 EUR annual figure shown, plus the semester contribution.

name: MSc Data and Computer Science
overview: Mathematics-heavy computer science at Germany's oldest university. Baden-Wurttemberg non-EU tuition of 1,500 EUR per semester applies.

name: MSc Electrical Engineering and Information Technology
overview: KIT combines a university and a national research centre, giving master's students access to large-scale laboratories. Baden-Wurttemberg non-EU tuition of 1,500 EUR per semester applies.

name: MSc Mechanical Engineering
overview: A traditional strength of KIT, with specialisations in energy, mobility and production technology. Baden-Wurttemberg non-EU tuition applies.

name: MSc Information Technology
overview: Embedded systems, communications and microelectronics, in a city built around engineering industry. Baden-Wurttemberg non-EU tuition of 1,500 EUR per semester applies.

name: MSc Water Resources Engineering and Management
overview: Hydrology, hydraulic engineering and water management - directly relevant to delta and flood engineering work in Bangladesh. Baden-Wurttemberg non-EU tuition applies.

name: MSc Computational Modelling and Simulation
overview: Saxony charges no tuition to non-EU students, and Dresden's living costs are among the lowest of any major German university city. The figure shown is the annual semester contribution.

name: MSc Hydro Science and Engineering
overview: Water management, hydrology and environmental engineering taught in English. No tuition for non-EU students; the figure shown is the annual semester contribution.

name: MA International Relations
overview: Run jointly with Freie Universitat Berlin and the Hertie School. No tuition for non-EU students; the figure shown is the Berlin semester contribution for two semesters.

name: MSc Environmental Sciences
overview: Forest and environmental sciences with strong fieldwork provision in the Black Forest. Baden-Wurttemberg non-EU tuition of 1,500 EUR per semester applies.

name: MSc Renewable Energy Engineering and Management
overview: Solar, wind and energy-system management, taught in English. Baden-Wurttemberg non-EU tuition applies.

name: Programs in English at Komaba (PEAK) - Environmental Sciences
overview: A four-year undergraduate degree taught entirely in English. National-university fees apply; the University of Tokyo charges the raised undergraduate rate permitted by MEXT rules.

name: Master of Science in Computer Science
overview: Graduate study at the MEXT standard national-university rate, which the university continues to apply at master's level. A one-off admission fee of JPY 282,000 is payable on entry.

name: Kyoto iUP Undergraduate Programme in Science
overview: An undergraduate route for international students beginning with a preparatory period, charged at the MEXT standard national-university rate.

name: Master of Engineering
overview: Graduate engineering study at the standard national-university rate of JPY 535,800 per year.

name: Master of Science in Engineering
overview: English-medium graduate engineering programme at the MEXT standard rate.

name: Future Global Leadership - Advanced Molecular Chemistry
overview: An undergraduate degree taught wholly in English. The application screening fee for FGL programmes is reduced to JPY 5,000.

name: Master of Information Sciences
overview: Graduate study in information sciences at the standard national-university rate.

name: G30 Automotive Engineering
overview: Part of the G30 International Programs, taught entirely in English at the standard national-university rate.

name: Master of Engineering in Civil Engineering
overview: English-medium graduate programme at the MEXT standard national-university rate.

name: Integrated Science Program
overview: A broad English-taught undergraduate science degree; the screening fee for English-taught programmes is reduced to JPY 5,000.

name: Master of Life Sciences
overview: Graduate life-sciences study at the standard national-university rate, based in Japan's largest science city.

name: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science and Engineering
overview: A private-university English-taught degree. Private tuition in Japan commonly runs JPY 800,000-1,500,000 per year depending on the field.

name: PEARL - Bachelor of Arts in Economics
overview: An English-taught economics degree at Japan's oldest private university.

name: Master's Programme in Data Science
overview: Non-EU tuition at Helsinki runs EUR 13,000-18,000 per year by programme. Scholarships are decided at admission and the full award adds a EUR 10,000 annual living grant.

name: Master's Programme in Environmental Change and Global Sustainability
overview: A two-year English-taught master's at the lower end of Helsinki's non-EU fee range. EU/EEA citizens pay no tuition.

name: Master of Science in Computer, Communication and Information Sciences
overview: Aalto sets non-EU master's fees per school: EUR 17,000 a year for technology. Excellence Scholarships award 50% or 100% tuition waivers at admission.

name: Master of Science in Finance
overview: Business-school master's at Aalto's non-EU business rate of EUR 15,000 per year.

name: Bachelor of Science in Technology
overview: Non-EU bachelor's tuition in business and technology is EUR 12,000 a year, reduced by an automatic 25% discount in the first year.

name: Master's Degree Programme in Information and Communication Technology
overview: English-taught master's within Finland's EUR 8,000-18,000 non-EU research-university band.

name: Master's Programme in Computing Sciences
overview: Two-year English-medium master's; scholarships covering 50-100% of tuition are awarded at admission to strong non-EU applicants.

name: Master's Programme in Sustainable Business and Technology
overview: An interdisciplinary master's combining engineering and management, taught in English.

name: Master's Programme in Wireless Communications Engineering
overview: Oulu's established strength is wireless communications; the programme is taught in English and open to non-EU applicants at the stated annual fee.

name: Master's Degree Programme in Education
overview: Finland's best-known education faculty, teaching an English-medium master's in educational sciences.

name: Master's Programme in Energy Technology
overview: A technology master's focused on energy systems and the clean-energy transition.

name: Master's Degree Programme in Forestry (European Forestry)
overview: An English-taught forestry master's drawing on Finland's forest-sector research base.

name: Bachelor of Computing in Computer Science
overview: Fee shown is the subsidised rate for non-ASEAN international students holding the MOE Tuition Grant, which carries a three-year Singapore work bond. Without the grant the published rate is substantially higher.

name: Master of Computing in Artificial Intelligence
overview: A coursework master's in artificial intelligence. Graduate fees at NUS are set per programme rather than by the undergraduate grant scheme.

name: Master of Science in Business Analytics
overview: A business-analytics master's taught jointly by the School of Computing and NUS Business School. GRE or GMAT may be required.

name: Bachelor of Engineering in Electrical and Electronic Engineering
overview: The 2026-intake subsidised rate for non-ASEAN international students with the MOE Tuition Grant was SGD 21,400 a year for lab-based programmes and is fixed until graduation. Without the grant the lab-based rate was SGD 40,600.

name: Master of Science in Artificial Intelligence
overview: A one-year coursework master's in artificial intelligence at NTU's College of Computing and Data Science.

name: Bachelor of Accountancy
overview: Accountancy and business programmes carry a slightly higher subsidised rate: SGD 21,800 a year with the MOE Tuition Grant for the 2026 intake.

name: Bachelor of Science in Information Systems
overview: A seminar-based undergraduate degree at SMU's city campus. International students may apply for the MOE Tuition Grant on the same service-obligation terms.

name: Master of Science in Computer Science
overview: KFUPM funds its graduate students: admitted master's and PhD candidates commonly receive full tuition cover, on-campus housing, a monthly allowance, medical cover and travel.

name: Master of Science in Petroleum Engineering
overview: Graduate petroleum engineering at Saudi Arabia's leading technical university, normally fully funded for admitted international students.

name: Master of Science in Computer Science
overview: Every admitted KAUST student receives the KAUST Fellowship automatically: full tuition, housing, medical and dental cover, relocation support and a living allowance. There is no separate scholarship application.

name: PhD in Environmental Science and Engineering
overview: Doctoral study under the automatic KAUST Fellowship, with Red Sea marine and desert environment research facilities.

name: Bachelor of Science in Engineering
overview: Reachable through the Ministry of Education's unified scholarship portal, which typically covers tuition, accommodation, a monthly stipend, annual flights and health insurance.

name: Master of Business Administration
overview: Postgraduate business study in Jeddah, available to international students through the national scholarship platform.

name: Master's Degree in Artificial Intelligence
overview: Catalonia sets higher regulated per-credit rates for non-EU students than most Spanish regions. Official master's fees at public universities commonly fall between EUR 1,000 and EUR 3,500 a year for EU citizens and higher for non-EU applicants.

name: Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration
overview: Non-EU undergraduates at Catalan public universities pay a regulated rate several times the EU rate; the EU rate elsewhere in Spain is roughly EUR 750-2,500 a year.

name: Bachelor in Computer Science and Engineering
overview: UC3M teaches an unusually large English-taught undergraduate catalogue. Madrid applies a higher regulated rate to non-EU students.

name: Master in Economic Analysis
overview: A one-year English-taught economics master's at a Madrid public university.

name: Master in Data Science
overview: A research-oriented data science master's at one of Spain's strongest social-science and computing faculties.

name: Master's Degree in International Relations
overview: Postgraduate study at Spain's largest public university; teaching is partly in Spanish and language requirements vary by track.

name: BSc in Computer Engineering
overview: METU teaches entirely in English. International undergraduate fees at Turkish state universities are low by international standards and are set per university each year.

name: MSc in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
overview: Graduate engineering taught in English at Türkiye's foremost technical university.

name: BA in Economics
overview: An English-medium undergraduate degree at one of Türkiye's most selective universities. Admission for international applicants is normally via TR-YOS or an accepted equivalent.

name: MA in International Relations
overview: Postgraduate study taught in English on the Bosphorus campus.

name: BSc in Civil Engineering
overview: One of the world's oldest technical universities; a substantial share of ITU's catalogue is taught in English.

name: MSc in Architecture
overview: Graduate architecture study in Istanbul, taught in English.

name: BSc in Mechanical Engineering
overview: A private English-medium university. Koc operates a substantial merit scholarship programme that reduces or removes tuition for strong applicants.

name: MSc in Data Science
overview: Graduate data science at a private research university in Istanbul, with scholarship support available at admission.

name: Master's Programme in Computer Science
overview: Non-EU students at Austrian public universities pay a tuition fee fixed in law at EUR 726.72 per semester, the same at every public university regardless of subject, plus the Austrian Students' Union fee.

name: Master's Programme in Environmental Sciences
overview: Taught at Austria's largest university at the statutory non-EU rate of EUR 726.72 per semester.

name: Master's Programme in Data Science
overview: An English-taught data science master's at Vienna's technical university, at the statutory public-university rate for non-EU students.

name: Master's Programme in Embedded Systems
overview: Graduate study in embedded and cyber-physical systems, taught in English.

name: Master's Programme in Computer Science
overview: English-taught computer science at TU Graz, charged at the statutory non-EU rate.

name: Master's Programme in Environmental Management of Mountain Areas
overview: A specialised Alpine environmental master's, taught at the statutory public-university rate.

name: Master's Programme in Artificial Intelligence
overview: JKU runs one of the German-speaking world's dedicated AI master's degrees, taught in English at the statutory non-EU rate.
